description.html: Dragon stone, also known as Ohko stone, is one of the most popular decorative stones in aquascaping and terrarium design. It has a unique holey look with deep cavities that resembles the surface of the moon or dragon skin. Every piece is unique in shape and texture, which lets you create one-of-a-kind layouts.

It is chemically inert - it does not affect pH or water hardness, so it is completely safe for all types of aquariums. In terrariums it serves as a decorative element and a climbing surface. In aquariums it is used to build hardscape - stone formations that form the base of an aquascape. Mosses and low plants attach easily to the porous surface, creating a natural, aged look.
